## File: facebookresearch_banmo/third_party/kmeans_pytorch/kmeans_pytorch/soft_dtw_cuda.py

Prompts

```
['build a pytorch module that computes soft DTW loss between two batches of time series sequences', 'run the SoftDTW forward pass to compute differentiable DTW distance between two sequence tensors on GPU', 'create a function that calculates the pairwise euclidean distance matrix between two batches of sequences', 'test the timed_run function to benchmark forward and backward pass timing for soft DTW', 'profile the SoftDTW module comparing CPU and GPU performance across different batch sizes and sequence lengths']
```

Usage

```
{'build_SoftDTW_module': 'build a pytorch module that computes soft DTW loss between two batches of time series sequences', 'run_SoftDTW_forward': 'run the SoftDTW forward pass to compute differentiable DTW distance between two sequence tensors on GPU', 'create_euclidean_dist_func': 'create a function that calculates the pairwise euclidean distance matrix between two batches of sequences', 'test_timed_run': 'test the timed_run function to benchmark forward and backward pass timing for soft DTW', 'profile_SoftDTW_cpu_gpu': 'profile the SoftDTW module comparing CPU and GPU performance across different batch sizes and sequence lengths'}
```
